Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, i As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("A4").Value = 4
        ws.Range("A5").Value = 5
        ws.Range("A6").Formula = "=SUM(A4:A5)"
        ws.Range("A7").Formula = "=A3+A6"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("A4").Value = 4
        ws.Range("A5").Value = 5
        ws.Range("A6").Formula = "=SUM(A4:A5)"
        ws.Range("A7").Formula = "=SUM(A3,A6)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=SUM(A2:A4)"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A4").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 2
        ws.Range("C1").Value = 3
        ws.Range("D1").Formula = "=SUM(A1:C1)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 2
        ws.Range("C1").Formula = "=SUM(A1:B1)"
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 3
        ws.Range("B2").Value = 4
        ws.Range("C2").Formula = "=SUM(A2:B2)"
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B2)"
        ws.Range("C3").Formula = "=SUM(C1:C2)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=A1+A2+A3"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A5").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A2:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A6").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A7").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A8").Formula = "=SUM(A6:A7)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A6").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A7").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A8").Formula = "=SUM(A6:A7)"
        ws.Range("A1:A4").AutoOutline
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "x"
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = "y"
        ws.Range("B2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = "Total"
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B2)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=AVERAGE(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=A1*2"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=A2"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Rows("1:2").Group: ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline: ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 18
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("C5").AutoOutline
    Case 19
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("B2").Formula = "=SUM(B1)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 20
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("B2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("B3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("B4").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 22
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A2:A3)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 23
        ws.Range("B1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("B2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("B3").Formula = "=SUM(B1:B2)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 24
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=SUBTOTAL(9,A1:A2)"
        ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
        ws.Range("A2").Value = 2
        ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
        ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(A1:A3)"
        ws.Outline.SummaryRow = xlSummaryAbove: ws.Range("A1").AutoOutline
    End Select
    s = "rows="
    For i = 1 To 12
        s = s & ws.Rows(i).OutlineLevel
    Next
    s = s & " cols="
    For i = 1 To 8
        s = s & ws.Columns(i).OutlineLevel
    Next
    s = s & " below=" & (ws.Outline.SummaryRow = xlSummaryBelow) & " right=" & (ws.Outline.SummaryColumn = xlSummaryOnRight)
    Tried = s
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
